title: METHODS FOR TESTING TAR AND BITUMINOUS MATERIALS - DETERMINATION OF RESIDUE OF SPECIFIED PENETRATION
clause_1_scope: This standard covers the method for the determination of residue of specified penetration of cutback bitumen.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Glossary of Terms Relating to Bitumen and Tar
Methods for Testing Tar and Bituminous Materials-Determination of Penetration

clause_3_terminology: METHODS FOR TESTING TAR AND BITUMINOUS MATERIALS
DETERMINATION OF RESIDUE OF SPECIFIED PENETRATION

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
